decisions.scientificAssessment: Six C and six attached H form a planar sigma-framework viewed obliquely. Each C carries one parallel p orbital with blue upper and orange lower lobes; continuous like-phase overlap is a qualitative bonding-pi model, not charges. Six pi-electrons are correctly stated. Both Kekule contributors have exactly three alternating double bonds, shifted by one position, connected with a resonance double-headed arrow. The delocalized-state energy is lower than the hypothetical localized comparison; the vertical arrow is a qualitative stabilization difference, not a kinetic pathway, equilibrium or measured numeric energy.
decisions.mobileAssessment: Native1672×941 and actual316×178/360×203/680×383 viewed. Six C/H centres, lobes,6pi label, resonance pair, energy-level order remain distinguishable at360. Secondary energy captions are small but legible. Actual680px image is below448px GoalCard height cap and uncropped.
decisions.orientationLimit: One qualitative benzene model supports this goal; the full quantum MO energy-level occupation, other aromatic systems and152kJ/mol model comparison belong to explanation/practice. Blue/orange orbital phases are stated in alt text.

currentResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: Bindungsverhältnisse aromatischer Systeme modellieren
currentResourceLink.description: Benzol als planarer σ-Ring mit seitlich überlappenden p-Orbitalen, mesomeren Grenzformeln und qualitativem Energievergleich.
currentResourceLink.altText: Schematisches Benzolmodell: sechs parallele p-Orbitale mit oberen und unteren Lappen überlappen über einem planaren Sechsring; jeder Kohlenstoff trägt ein H. Zwei Kekulé-Grenzformeln zeigen Mesomerie. Ein qualitativer Vergleich setzt den delokalisierten Zustand tiefer als einen hypothetischen lokalisierten Zustand; die Farben sind Orbitalphasen, keine Ladungen.

blockingFindings.detail: The explicit azo product ring skeletons have top/bottom vertices and vertical left/right C–C edges. Each N–aryl single bond meets the midpoint of a vertical ring edge rather than one of the six aromatic carbon vertices. OH likewise leaves the midpoint of the rightmost vertical edge. This is not a valid depiction of Ph–N=N–C6H4–OH: it visually attaches substituents to C–C bonds or introduces extra implicit carbon junctions. Actual native product-region crop and360/680 views confirm all three misplaced attachments. Correct captions/alt text do not repair this structural drawing.
blockingFindings.correction: Redraw or rotate the two explicit benzene skeletons so each N–aryl bond and the para-OH bond terminates at a genuine ring carbon vertex, retaining exactly six ring atoms and three alternating double bonds. Preserve neutral N=N, +H+ and intended activated-phenol coupling.

decisions.scientificAssessment: Ph–N2+ + phenol -> para-hydroxyazobenzene +H+ is an appropriate intended local coupling and its written charge balance is correct; the actual product attachment graph is wrong. The right route is an explicitly abbreviated conceptual condensation/oxidation: central leuco C has four bonds (Ph,Ar,Ar,H), cation C has three aryl bonds and+charge. With donor-substituted Ar defined in actual authoredcase and alt text this can orient toward triphenylmethane dyes; omitted H2O/oxidant/H+/electrons/counterions mean it is not a complete equation or mechanism. These correct fragments do not rescue the faulty explicit left skeleton.
decisions.mobileAssessment: Native and316/360/680 cap448 viewed; major headings/reactant symbols,N=N,H+,central C-H andC+ are distinguishable at360. The bond-placement fault remains visible at680/native; it is not merely a raster-size problem.
decisions.orientationLimit: Do not integrate this exact PNG as accepted V. No production asset exists for this formerly missing image, and the17 existing images remain untouched. A corrected actual raster requires fresh exact-hash V inspection.

currentResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: Azo- und Triphenylmethanfarbstoffe mechanistisch darstellen
currentResourceLink.description: Azokupplung mit Phenol und abgekürzte Kondensations-/Oxidationsroute von der Leukoverbindung zum Triarylmethyl-Farbstoffkation.
currentResourceLink.altText: Zwei abgekürzte Farbstoff-Synthesewege: Benzenediazonium und Phenol koppeln zu para-Hydroxyazobenzol mit N=N-Brücke unter Protonenabgabe. Eine Kondensation mit donor-substituierten Arylresten erzeugt die Leukoverbindung mit vier zentralen C-Bindungen; Oxidation liefert ein triarylmethylisches Farbstoffkation mit drei C-Bindungen. Ar/Ph sind Restabkürzungen; die rechte Route lässt Wasser, Oxidant, Protonen/Elektronen und Gegenionen aus und ist keine vollständige Gleichung.

decisions.scientificAssessment: Benzene and the neutral substituted product each have three alternating ring double bonds. In the sigma-complex the attacked carbon has two ring single bonds plusH andE (four sigma bonds,sp3); it has no remaining pi bond. Two ring double bonds and the+charge at an adjacent carbon give a correct individual arenium contributor and interrupted aromaticity. Loss ofH+ followed by the restored third pi bond is correct; E replacesH. A base/counterions and electron-pair arrows are intentionally omitted from this compact orientation, and supplied authoredcases demand them independently. No hydride departure, retained aromatic sigma-complex or four-bond positive carbon is drawn.
decisions.mobileAssessment: Native and316/360/680 cap448 viewed. E+,H/E at attackedC,ring+charge,two versus three double bonds,-H+,nonaromatic/aromatic labels are all recognizable at360. 680×383 is naturally under448px and uncropped.
decisions.orientationLimit: This is one sigma-complex contributor plus main stage sequence; not a complete mechanism/electron-arrow assessment or claim of permanently localized ring charge.

currentResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: σ-Komplex-Mechanismus
currentResourceLink.description: Elektrophiler Ringangriff, nicht aromatischer σ-Komplex und Wiederherstellung des aromatischen π-Systems durch Protonenabgabe.
currentResourceLink.altText: Elektrophile aromatische Substitution in drei schematischen Stufen: ein Elektrophil wird am Benzol gebunden; der nicht aromatische σ-Komplex hat am angegriffenen Kohlenstoff H und E, zwei verbleibende Doppelbindungen und positive Ringladung am Nachbar-C. Eine Base, hier ausgeblendet, nimmt ein Proton auf; der neutral substituierte Aromat erhält sein π-System zurück.
